summary: Ezekiel is shown the valley of dry bones—Israel will inherit the land in the Resurrection—The stick of Judah (the Bible) and the stick of Joseph (the Book of Mormon) will become one in the Lord’s hand—The children of Israel will be gathered and cleansed—David (the Messiah) will reign over them—They will receive the everlasting gospel covenant.

footnotes.note16_a: HEB wood. Wooden writing tablets were in common use in Babylon in Ezekiel’s day. Num. 17:2 (1–10). TG Scriptures to Come Forth.
footnotes.note22_d: The tribes led by Judah and by Ephraim were historically adversaries (after events of 1 Kgs. 12:16–20). In the latter days this enmity will be healed.
